superseded_members.ConfigurationRecorders[1].recording: The pack set a `recording` flag on the stored configuration recorder when it was started or stopped. ConfigurationRecorder declares no such member -- whether a recorder is running is reported by DescribeConfigurationRecorderStatus, which this service does not serve -- so it was a member no SDK could read off a described recorder. The bundle does not store it, and start and stop change nothing either way, which is what the flag amounted to. Every other member of these steps is still compared.
